title: yuhangshi888/zeta-simple-zeros-673316977
abstract: A Lean 4 and Mathlib formalization of the supporting-plane and exact-arithmetic portion of the finite-dimensional argument in Yuhang Shi's research draft on simple zeros of the Riemann zeta function. It proves a conditional scalar two-certificate supporting-plane implication, its explicit piecewise-square-root specialization at block length 219, and the exact strict comparison above 673316977/10^9 for the resulting local assembly expression. The spectral derivation of the trace-envelope alternative, the upstream seven- and nine-point interval certificates, and the analytic passage from finite blocks to a global zeta-zero proportion are not formalized here and are not claimed as Palomar-verified conclusions.
